title: One illustrative request: where time goes
method: Synthetic serial request: 20 + 60 + 20 = 100 milliseconds. Intervals do not overlap. Halving CPU work saves 10 milliseconds; this is a model, not measured service latency.
alt: One illustrative request: where time goes. CPU execution: 20 milliseconds; Storage wait: 60 milliseconds; Network wait: 20 milliseconds. Illustrative inputs.
